## Query

| | |
|---|---|
| Dataset | `bluelink-daily-salt` ([forms](../../published.md)) |
| Location | nearest to 147 E, 44 S; depth level nearest 5 m |
| Selections | one value on the last day; the 51-level profile on the last day; the last 30 days at that depth |
| Requests | 1, 51 and 30 source chunks (`salt` chunks are 1 x 1 x 300 x 300) |
| Result | not yet recorded |

## icechunk + xarray

[partial]{.status .status-partial} cloud session, 2026-11-02 (icechunk
2.3.1, zarr 3.4.2, xarray 2026.9.0): storage, config, authorization, open
and coordinates in about 3 s; data reads not run there (THREDDS
unreachable from that environment).

```python
import icechunk as ic, xarray as xr, zarr

storage = ic.s3_storage(
    bucket="us-west-2.opendata.source.coop",
    prefix="ausantarctic/ausantarctic-scratch/bluelink/bluelink-daily-salt/icechunk",
    region="us-west-2", anonymous=True)
config = ic.Repository.fetch_config(storage)    # the repo's own config
config.max_concurrent_requests = 4
auth = {c.url_prefix: ic.credentials.HttpAccess  # https://thredds.nci.org.au/
        for c in config.virtual_chunk_containers.values()}
repo = ic.Repository.open(storage, config=config, authorize_virtual_chunk_access=auth)
zarr.config.set({"async.concurrency": 4})       # THREDDS resets at the default 10

ds = xr.open_zarr(repo.readonly_session("main").store, consolidated=False, chunks=None)
salt = ds.salt
point   = salt.sel(xt_ocean=147, yt_ocean=-44, st_ocean=5, method="nearest").isel(Time=-1).load()
profile = salt.sel(xt_ocean=147, yt_ocean=-44, method="nearest").isel(Time=-1).load()
series  = salt.sel(xt_ocean=147, yt_ocean=-44, st_ocean=5, method="nearest").isel(Time=slice(-30, None)).load()
```

## gdalxarray, mdim VRT

[not run]{.status .status-todo} for salt; the same call on temp is
[ok]{.status .status-ok} in [the temperature example](../bluelink-temp-latitude-line/index.qmd).

```python
import xarray as xr
ds = xr.open_dataset(
    "/vsicurl/https://data.source.coop/ausantarctic/ausantarctic-scratch/"
    "virtual/bluelink-daily-salt/mdim.vrt",
    engine="gdalxarray", chunks=None,
    config_options={"GDAL_DISABLE_READDIR_ON_OPEN": "EMPTY_DIR",
                    "GDAL_HTTP_MAX_RETRY": "3", "GDAL_HTTP_RETRY_DELAY": "2"})
salt = ds.salt
profile = salt.sel(xt_ocean=147, yt_ocean=-44, method="nearest").isel(Time=-1).load()
```
